machine_start_gcode.default_value:
;Machine Model: {machine_name}
;Nozzle Size: {machine_nozzle_size}
;Sliced at: {day} {date} {time}
;--- Penrose 600 Pellet Extruder Start GCode ---
M140 S{material_bed_temperature_layer_0} 	;Heat build surface
M104 T0 S{material_print_temperature_layer_0} 	;Heat nozzle
M104 H0 S{material_barrel_temperature_layer_0} 	;Heat barrel
M190 S{material_bed_temperature_layer_0} 	;Wait for bed temperature
M109 T0 S{material_print_temperature_layer_0} 	;Wait for nozzle temperature
M109 H0 S{material_barrel_temperature_layer_0} 	;Wait for barrel temperature
G21 ;metric values
M107 ;fan off
G28 ;home all axes
M420 S1 ;restore bed level mesh
G90 ;absolute positioning
G1 X0 Y0 Z5 F5000 ;move nozzle up 5mm for safe homing
G29 ;auto bed leveling
M500 ;save settings
M82 ;set extruder to absolute mode
M107 ;start with the fan off
G1 X0 Y0 Z15.0 F5000 ;move the platform down 15mm

; Pellet extruder purge sequence
G92 E0 ;reset extruder position
G0 Z0.4 F500 ;move to purge height
G0 X30 E5 F300 ;slow purge
G92 E0 ;reset extruder position
G0 X60 E5 F500 ;medium purge
G92 E0 ;reset extruder position
G0 X100 E5 F800 ;fast purge
G0 X{100 + 5} Z{0.1} F{8000} ;wipe move close to bed
G0 X{100 + 10} Z0.4 F{8000} ;wipe move away from bed

G92 E0 ;zero the extruded length
M117 Printing...

M300 S880 P166
M300 S0 P166
M300 S880 P166
M300 S1318 P166
M300 S1567 P166
M300 S0 P166

machine_end_gcode.default_value:
;--- Penrose 600 Pellet Extruder End GCode ---
M104 T0 S0 ;extruder heater off
M104 H0 S0 ;barrel heater off
M140 S0 ;heated bed heater off
G91 ;relative positioning
G1 Z+0.5 E-2 F3000 ;move Z up a bit and retract slightly
G28 ;move to home
M84 ;steppers off
M107 ;fan off
G90 ;absolute positioning
